message: Deep license enforcement fix. Revocation is now hardware-bound as well as License-ID-bound, closing the duplicate-key bypass where several AITL2 keys existed for one machine. The client discovers the protected core directly from Windows loopback listeners, reads the core-reported licenseId and hardwareId from /api/status, fails closed when no protected identity can be bound, clears stale core revocation caches, checks a single-file signed revocation bundle every 2 seconds, persists the bound identity for startup preflight, and immediately terminates a session when either its License ID or Hardware ID is blocked. The matching admin publishes JSON, signature and signed bundle atomically and Revoke/Delete block the hardware; Restore unblocks it.
